selection_rule: Retain all six P22 tasks, including both successes, in the same order. No extra confirmation scenario or task-specific target supplied.
server_lease_basis: Use existing unchanged single-slot M3 64K server lease; verify actual supervisor and at least 12060 seconds remaining before beginning. No concurrent heavy inference.
scope: Same six already observed development scenarios, known generic instructions contrast only; not confirmatory or new-method efficacy evidence.
discovery_policy: Initially api_docs and supervisor schemas. A requested app description exposes that public app; individual API documentation exposes that API. New schemas apply on the next model response. No answer-based selection or silent top-k pruning.
interpretation: Same model, public tools, full history, seed and per-trial budgets as P22.
Only the fixed generic environment guidance is appended to the system instruction. This is ordinary baseline calibration, not a novel method.
The guidance source is the pinned official instruction file; no demonstrations or task trajectories are read.
No task datetime, hidden answer, target list or evaluation result is supplied to generation. The public clock must be requested through the documented API.
P23 ordinary Python runtime is prepared but not used here; available tools stay unchanged.
P22 was reviewed before this plan; these are development comparisons and selection bias is acknowledged.
All six executions finish before interpretation; no partial-result changes or automatic retries.
Snapshots do not capture full process RNG or KV-cache state.
history_representation: Append-only public assistant content/calls and tool observations; no reasoning replay. Same archive page size. Invalid argument turns use text fallback preserving raw calls and actual results.
